dogecoin.text: Dogecoin fell 10% as Bitcoin dropped to below $96K, sparking $560M in liquidations. Analysts cite profit-taking and macro concerns, with altcoins hit hardest in the volatile downturn. The event highlights the risks of leveraged crypto positions.

Jan 2025: Dogecoin hit $0.40 before settling at $0.36 after its logo appeared on the D.O.G.E. agency site. Bitcoin peaked at $110K, dipping to $101K post-inauguration. TRUMP and MELANIA meme coins saw brief billion-dollar caps before declining.
Solana, Dogecoin, and XRP each dropped over 10% as the week began, $770 million in long position liquidations across markets.
